cases.name: service locator debt does not grow
no model imports the http layer
permission algorithm has a single owner

detector_method: token_get_all(); a hit requires an unqualified app(/resolve(/App::make( call not preceded by ::, ->, ?->, new, class or function
defects_found_in_the_detector_itself: Previous-token lookups scanned forwards, so 'function resolve(' declarations were reported as container calls. Fixed by scanning backwards.
PHP 8 emits Foo\Bar as a single T_NAME_QUALIFIED array token, so naive concatenation produced array-to-string warnings and no import data. Fixed by reading token[1].
Re-tokenising per lookup made the suite take 13.69s; a per-file token cache reduced it to 0.29s.
regression_coverage_added: Zero service locators in Domain and Application
Exact-pinning of the 18 known locator call sites
Rule 12: no Model -> Http import (protects the Phase 0.13 fix)
Rule 2: no framework facade in Domain
